ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the figure there is a circle, P is marked inside the circle as the center of the circle, G, E, N, and M are all on the circumference; from G to E and N respectively there are line segments, so ∠EGN is an angle whose vertex is on the circumference. The problem gives the measure of minor arc EN as 66°, and also gives ∠GPM=89°. Reasoning: ∠EGN is an inscribed angle, and the arc intercepted by its two sides GE and GN is arc EN. According to the inscribed angle theorem, the measure of an inscribed angle is equal to half the measure of the arc it intercepts, so m∠EGN = 1/2 × 66 = 33. The given m∠GPM=89° does not need to be used to find ∠EGN.

raw_record.question_text: In $\odot P$, $m\widehat{EN}=66$ and $m\angle GPM=89$. Find $m\angle EGN$.

method.method_draft: Read the diagram as a circle centered at P with G, E, N, and M on the circumference, and with angle EGN formed by chords GE and GN. From the text, use the given minor arc measure m arc EN = 66. Since ∠EGN is an inscribed angle whose sides intercept arc EN, apply the inscribed angle theorem: m∠EGN = 1/2 · m arc EN = 33. The given m∠GPM = 89 is not needed for this target angle.
method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：图中是一个圆，P 标在圆内作为圆心，G、E、N、M 都在圆周上；从 G 向 E 和 N 分别有线段，所以 ∠EGN 是顶点在圆周上的角。题目给出小弧 EN 的度数为 66°，还给出 ∠GPM=89°。
推理：∠EGN 是一个圆周角，它的两边 GE 和 GN 截到的弧是弧 EN。根据圆周角定理，圆周角的度数等于其所截弧度数的一半，所以 m∠EGN = 1/2 × 66 = 33。给出的 m∠GPM=89° 对求 ∠EGN 不需要使用。

method.method_draft: Weakly distinct variant: First read from the diagram that P is the center of the circle and E and N are endpoints of the arc intercepted by ∠EGN. From the text, m arc EN = 66, so the central angle ∠EPN subtending the same arc would also measure 66. Then compare the inscribed angle ∠EGN to the central angle ∠EPN subtending the same arc: an inscribed angle is half the corresponding central angle, so m∠EGN = 66/2 = 33. The 89-degree central angle ∠GPM concerns arc GM and is irrelevant to arc EN.
method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：图中是一个以 P 为中心的圆，点 G、E、N、M 都在圆上。角 EGN 的顶点在圆上的点 G，两条边分别经过 E 和 N，因此它截得的是弧 EN。题目给出弧 EN 的度数为 66，并且还给出中心角 GPM 为 89。

推理：在圆中，截同一条弧的圆周角等于对应中心角或弧度数的一半。因为角 EGN 截得弧 EN，而 m弧EN = 66，所以 m∠EGN = 66 ÷ 2 = 33。给出的 m∠GPM = 89 对应的是另一段弧，与弧 EN 无关。
